description: Full body portrait of a Malaysian female police officer in her early 30s. She wears a crisp, dark blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform with a black hijab tucked into the collar, silver duty badges on her chest, and a black utility belt. She is standing with a professional posture, wearing black tactical boots.

Full body portrait of an elderly Malaysian woman in her late 60s. She has a gentle face and wears spectacles. She is wearing a traditional floral Baju Kurung with a matching pastel-colored loose headscarf (tudung), simple sandals, and a small gold watch on her wrist.

Full body anonymous human figure standing in the shadows. A featureless, matte-black silhouette with no visible facial features. The figure is wearing a dark, oversized hoodie and cargo pants, with glowing blue circuit-pattern lines subtly tracing down the arms to represent a digital threat.
